app.name: AIRoof
app.title: AI receptionist and CRM for roofing companies
app.descriptor: Answers calls, books jobs, and runs the job file.
app.purpose: Bilingual call intake, inspection booking, job tracking, crew updates, quotes, reports, and invoices for roofing companies.
app.payments: Stripe and Stripe Connect Standard direct charges (integration present; production unconfigured; Connect setup and webhook required)
app.ai: ElevenLabs (voice; phone line runs gpt-4o since 2026-10-31 (gemini-2.5-flash is the tested fallback), browser demo gpt-4o-mini), OpenAI (speech and parsing), DeepSeek (classification), Vapi (legacy voice)

alerts.text: ElevenLabs Creator credits reset (214,953/month). The plan cannot go over its credits: when they run out the phone line stops answering. Move to a bigger plan before a client goes live.

OpenAI shuts down gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4.1 in its API. The phone line runs gpt-4o again since 2026-10-31; move it (gemini-2.5-flash passed the same tests), the browser demo, field-note reading and call summaries.
